summary.text: Kim Hammer is the Republican nominee for Arkansas secretary of state and a state senator from Benton, where he represents District 16. A pastor and retired hospice chaplain, he chaired the Senate Efficiency Committee in the 2025-2026 session.

paragraphs.text: Hammer lives in Benton, and his career experience includes working as a chaplain and pastor with Saline Memorial Hospice.
He served eight years in the Arkansas House of Representatives before his election to the state Senate in 2018.
In 2025 he sponsored a package of bills on the signature-gathering process for petitions to place initiatives on the ballot.
Hammer won the March 31, 2026 Republican runoff for secretary of state over Bryan Norris by 913 of 80,977 votes cast, and a recount in six counties returned the same totals.
